newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare Group sees higher EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare Group sees higher EPS growth.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc, which posted earnings of $1.17 for the 10 months ended December 31, up from $1.01 a year ago, said it looks for a higher rate of earnings-per-share growth in 1997.
The company recently changed its fiscal year to December 31 from February 28.

"Combined with favorable prospects for our existing service lines, we are anticipating the resumption of a higher growth rate in earnings per share in calendar 1997 than was achieved this past period," said president James Usdan in a statement.

Usdan noted that RehabCare, which provides acute rehabilitation and other services, "is in position to continue building on our goal of broadening the range of venues where we manage delivery of therapy-based services."
